title: The Qualifying Test
summary: Gu He tells Yan Xiao that his master understands Heavenly Flames better than he does and asks where to find him, but Xiao Yan says his master meets no outsiders. Chairman Fa Ma explains that candidates recommended by the branches must refine a herb, the Black Iron Spiritual Leaf, into as pure an extract as possible before the timer runs out. Xiao Yan keeps his Green Lotus Core Flame hidden so that Gu He will not recognise it, and works with the Purple Flame instead. Gu He says he returns to the Misty Cloud Sect the next day and hints that such a talent belongs there, while over drinks Hai Bodong asks after the darkness-type Dou Huang and hears that Chu Yun Empire spies are gathering in the capital. Liu Ling and Princess Yue Er finish quickly, but the Searing Poison flares inside Xiao Yan and he falls far behind. He fights the poison down with willpower and finishes the extraction just as the round ends.
events: Gu He praises Yan Xiao's unseen master and asks to visit him.
Ao Tuo introduces Yan Xiao to Gu He and Fa Ma.
Fa Ma sets the test: extract the herbs to the purest state within the time limit.
Xiao Yan uses the Purple Flame to hide his Heavenly Flame from Gu He.
Fa Ma and Gu He discuss the Chu Yun Empire's three-tier entrants.
Hai Bodong's friend promises a bounty in the North Region for the darkness-type Dou Huang and warns of Chu Yun spies.
The Searing Poison flares; Xiao Yan suppresses it while Liu Ling and Yue Er finish.
Xiao Yan completes the extraction at the last moment.
